work_completed: Built the complete apps/web Next.js 15 flagship playground with App Router pages, API routes, shared components, prompts, agent wrappers, and vitest coverage.
Added governance artifacts for session registration, intent logging, and handoff documentation.
Validated apps/web with npm install, npx tsc --noEmit, npm run build, npm test, and confirmed root npm test still passes.
decisions_made: Client playground views call the local API routes so node-dependent agent packages stay server-side during Next.js builds.
AI Gateway augmentation is optional and activates only when AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY and a request model are both supplied.
Each agent foundation is created through its own dedicated createFoundation() path in src/lib/foundation.ts.
handoff_record.next_agent_notes: Pushing is intentionally deferred for Gate C review. If runtime model augmentation is needed, verify the deployed gateway base URL and model name contract.
